```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
heights <- read.table(here::here("data/height_67_girls_boys_data.txt"), skip = 10, 
header = TRUE)
```

## Prepare the data for analysis

```{r}
heights <- heights |> 
    mutate(sex = factor(sex, labels = c("boy", "girl")),
    id = factor(id))
```
```{r}
ggplot(heights, aes(y = height, x = year, group = id, color = sex)) + 
    geom_line() + geom_point()
```
